newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM no comment on Eurobond issue talk.
newsitem.headline: DSM no comment on Eurobond issue talk.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV said on Wednesday that conditions were favourable to tap the capital markets but it had no comment on speculation it planned a Eurobond issue.
Market sources said DSM was believed to be latest in a string of Dutch companies planning Eurobond issues, with a 10-year issue of up to 500 million guilders a possibility.

"We are continuously looking at our financial position. As we see it now the capital markets are quite favourable at the moment. Rates for financing are good," DSM's press relations manager Bert Holtkamp told Reuters.
He said DSM's cash position was excellent but it had made a number of acquisitions this year in Austria, Spain and Brazil.
DSM also made a cash payment to the Dutch state this year in compensation for the disposal of the state's 20 percent stake in the company.
"On the one hand we have an excellent cash position and on the other hand we have some cash out. What we will do is not yet decided," Holtkamp said.
The company's last venture into the international capital markets was in 1991 with a Eurobond issue.
